beamline_profile_patch.licence: BSD-3-Clause, like the profile it changes (written for this project)
beamline_profile_patch.what: lane tags on motorway/trunk/primary(+links), including the :both_ways centre-lane forms; roads with direction-dependent lane tags are not line-merged, so they keep the OSM way's direction; optional clamp of z15-only POIs, house numbers and private roads into the max zoom; POI kinds to leave out; optional unmerged buildings at the max zoom
beamline_profile_patch.history: 1 (2026-11-15, first round of this track): six lane keys, merged lines could reverse a two-way road's lanes:forward/backward and turn:lanes order. 2 (2026-11-15, review fixes): + lanes:both_ways, turn:lanes:both_ways; direction-dependent lane lines left out of the line merge.
